hook.title: Don't fix a bug you can't *reproduce*

scenes.title: Make it happen *on purpose*
scenes.body: Find the exact steps that trigger it. Then you'll know when it's really gone.

scenes.title: Write a *test* for it
scenes.body: One that fails now and passes after the fix. The bug can't sneak back.

scenes.after:
before the fix:  FAILED
after the fix:   PASSED
scenes.title: The test that *proves* it

end.title: Follow for more *code* tips
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
"I think I fixed it" isn't a fix.

First make the bug happen on purpose. Then write a test that fails because of it. Fix the code until the test passes. Now you know it's fixed, and if it ever comes back, the test catches it before your users do.
